target.patch_description: gdbusintrospection: Fix XML parser state handling for <node> element nesting

notes: Both builds created via Meson 1.11.2 with -Db_coverage=true -Doptimization=0 -Dtests=true
D-Bus session bus available for test execution

entries.reachability_signal: gcov shows 14 executions of line 1269, 4 executions of line 1271

contracts.detail: BEFORE (unpatched) at commit 7b276f05f accepted invalid XML silently (bug). AFTER (patched) at commit c9da977c rejects same inputs with G_MARKUP_ERROR_INVALID_CONTENT. Valid XML still parses correctly.

behavior_differences.before: Accepted malformed introspection XML with <node> inside non-<node> parents (silent parse)
behavior_differences.after: Rejected with G_MARKUP_ERROR_INVALID_CONTENT and proper error message
behavior_differences.evidence: gcov: line 1269 executed 14 times, line 1271 executed 4 times. BEFORE: 4 subtests passed. AFTER: 5 subtests passed.

notes: The patch adds test_invalid test with 5 malformed XML inputs: empty string + 4 invalid nesting patterns
Changed line 1269 (guard condition) executed 14 times; error path line 1271 executed 4 times

conclusion.rationale: The patch tightens input validation on the public API g_dbus_node_info_new_for_xml(). Previously accepted (malformed) introspection XML documents with <node> elements nested inside non-<node> parents are now correctly rejected with G_MARKUP_ERROR_INVALID_CONTENT. This is a bug fix correcting parser behavior per the D-Bus specification. Changed lines verified with 100% coverage through the gdbus-introspection test. All existing tests continue to pass.
recommended_actions: Verify no downstream D-Bus introspection consumers produce invalid XML with <node> inside interface/method/signal/property/arg elements
No code changes needed - this is a correct bug fix
Monitor for any regression reports from consumers with malformed introspection XML
